newsitem.title: UK: CU says '96 regular premium sales up 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: CU says '96 regular premium sales up 15 pct.

text.p: Commercial Union Life, the life assurance, endowment and pensions arm of Commercial Union Plc, said on Monday its sales in 1996 of regular premium products, including endowments and pension policies, grew by 15 percent.
In comments about its bonus rates for life customers it said 1996 had been "very successful", and many bonus rates had been maintained at the same level as in 1996.

"Against a pattern of continued lower inflation we are pleased to have maintained so many of our bonus rates at last year's levels. We are consistently providing the returns above inflation that all investors and savers are seeking," it added.
